ashley: Quick preflight / async standup — checked AMS1 lane headroom, found 2 nodes in Drain. No customer impact seen yet.

devon: Thanks. Any idea why they started draining?

ashley: Looks like `gpu-autoupgrade` kicked at 03:12 UTC — kernel patch. Saw nodes cordoned then drained. Planning to spin up replacements and keep labels intact.

maria: I opened INF-482 to track the drain + replacement flow. ETA to healthy replacements ~20m. @lee can you bump prewarm for ams1?

lee: On it — bumped prewarm +1 for ams1 and rebalanced spot pools. Ran: `kubectl scale deploy/gpu-warmers -n infra --replicas=3` and validated nodes are joining.

ops-bot: Autoscaler: scale-up event +2 for ams1 at ts=8276543250 :rocket:

devon: Quick ops/PR note — I have 2 PRs blocking the canary: #987 (autoscaler tweak) and #992 (node-annotator). @ashley can you review #992? small change to annotate kernel versions.

ashley: Will review in ~15m. Also quick ask: avoid changing `tenant-gpu-quota` configs during the replacement window unless we see real throttling.

maria: Blocker for me: perf CI flaky on packing tests. Re-running job in `perf-ci`. If it fails again, we fallback to current packing policy and open a follow-up.

lee: Note: APAC spot capacity looks thin tonight — <5 available nodes in apac1. I added a fallback route to eu in the routing config so requests move when apac <5: `fallback: { from: apac, to: eu }`

ashley: :thumbsup: Good catch. I'll monitor healthchecks and mark INF-482 resolved when replacements are Ready. Anyone want the night handoff?

devon: I can take night handoff — leaving notes + checklist in the ticket. Will watch autoscaler and routing alerts.
